_comment: Product categories for opportunity analysis. Stages: 1 foundation/early works, 2 structure/walling, 3 roofing, 4 plastering, 5 skimming/finishing prep, 6 painting under way, 7 complete/handed over. best_from..best_to is the ideal window; retrofit_to is the latest stage where retrofit options still make sense (null = none). groups: the category groups it is listed under (a category can be in more than one, e.g. Solar). pairs_with: categories to suggest alongside it in WhatsApp drafts (e.g. solar with a home cinema). Sync to the database with: uv run brains-bot-categories

categories.name: Home Audio & Multi-room
categories.description: Home cinema and multi-room audio systems, including in-ceiling and in-wall speakers, amplifiers and streaming.
categories.timing_note: Speaker cabling and back boxes go in before plastering; after that, wireless and surface-mounted options remain.

categories.name: Home Cinema
categories.description: Home cinema rooms: projectors and screens, automated reclining seating, acoustic wall panels and star-field ceilings.
categories.timing_note: The room layout, acoustic treatment and ceiling are planned before finishes; seating can be added at the end.

categories.name: Smart Home
categories.description: Smart lighting control, motorised blinds and curtains, smart climate control and whole-home automation.
categories.timing_note: Control wiring and conduit are easiest before plastering; wireless retrofit products exist for later stages.

categories.name: Security
categories.description: CCTV, alarms, electric fencing, access control, video doorbells and smart locks.
categories.timing_note: Camera and alarm cabling is easiest before plastering; wireless systems can be added later.

categories.name: Networking & IT
categories.description: Structured cabling and whole-home Wi-Fi mesh systems, needed for streaming audio and 4K video.
categories.timing_note: Structured cabling goes in before plastering; mesh Wi-Fi can be added at any time.

categories.name: Solar
categories.description: Solar PV and batteries, backup power and solar water heating.
categories.timing_note: Conduit and the inverter space are easiest to plan before plastering; panels and batteries can be added at any stage after that.

categories.name: Paint & Finishes
categories.description: Interior and exterior paint, premium and textured finishes, and wallpapers.
categories.timing_note: Paint and finish systems are chosen around plastering and skimming and applied before handover.

categories.name: Flooring
categories.description: Acoustic underlays, hardwood floors and carpets, especially for media rooms and cinemas.
categories.timing_note: Floor finishes are chosen during finishing and laid before or around painting.

categories.name: Lighting
categories.description: Light fittings, chandeliers, LED strips, downlights and lighting design.
categories.timing_note: Lighting points are wired before plastering; fittings go up during finishing.

categories.name: Joinery & Cabinets
categories.description: Kitchen and wardrobe cabinets, built-in media walls, doors and other custom joinery.
categories.timing_note: Measured and designed during finishing; installed near or after handover.

categories.name: Curtains & Blinds
categories.description: Curtains, blinds, rails and motorised window treatments.
categories.timing_note: Measured once windows and walls are finished; hung near or after handover.

categories.name: Waterproofing
categories.description: Waterproofing of roofs, flat slabs, terraces, balconies, bathrooms, water tanks and foundations; damp-proofing and sealants.
categories.timing_note: Roofs, slabs and wet areas are waterproofed after roofing and before tiling and finishes; leaks can still be fixed later, at a higher cost.

categories.name: Interior Design
categories.description: Interior design services: space planning, finishes and colour schemes, lighting design, furnishing and décor.
categories.timing_note: Design decisions are best made before finishes go in; décor and styling remain possible after handover.

categories.name: Paving
categories.description: Driveways, walkways and patios: cabro, stone and concrete paving.
categories.timing_note: Laid at the end of the build, once heavy machinery is off site.

categories.name: Gardens & Landscaping
categories.description: Landscape design, lawns, planting, irrigation and garden features.
categories.timing_note: Done at the end of the build, after paving and external works.

categories.name: Fencing & Gates
categories.description: Boundary walls, fencing, gates and gate automation.
categories.timing_note: Often built early to secure the site; gates and automation can come at any stage.

categories.name: Outdoor Audio
categories.description: Weatherproof garden and pool-side speakers and outdoor sound systems.
categories.timing_note: Outdoor speaker cabling is laid before paving and landscaping; wireless options remain afterwards.

categories.name: Outdoor Living
categories.description: Outdoor kitchens, pergolas, outdoor projectors and TVs, and garden lighting.
categories.timing_note: External cabling is best laid with landscaping works, which usually come late in the build.

categories.name: Water
categories.description: Water tanks, pumps, boreholes, water treatment and hot water systems.
categories.timing_note: Plumbing routes, tanks and pump positions are planned early; equipment can be upgraded later.

categories.name: Air Conditioning
categories.description: Split and ducted air conditioning, ventilation and heat pumps.
categories.timing_note: Refrigerant piping and drains go in before plastering; wall units can be retrofitted.
